final_candidates.decision_summary: ProteinMPNN conditional log-probability delta is positive (+0.316), the only structure-favorable candidate, indicating the backbone prefers proline at this flexible loop site. Proline-mediated loop rigidification is a classic folding-stability strategy, offsetting weak negative sequence/MSA signals since the objective is stability rather than evolutionary likelihood.

Conservative Tyr-to-Phe substitution with moderate positive signals across all tools (PLM 0.17, MSA 0.04, structure 0.49) and no contradictions. Aromatic-to-aromatic replacement preserves core packing while removing a polar OH, a stability-safe design.
